name: System-Wide Component Leave-One-Out Ablation
research_question: Which implemented subsystems contribute measurable changes to the system's runtime behavior, candidate assessment accuracy, and pacing?
hypothesis: Each separable subsystem provides a distinct, non-redundant contribution to candidate assessment, difficulty adaptation, or pacing control.

ablation_conditions.name: Full Production System
ablation_conditions.description: Complete multi-agent pipeline with PPO strategy, Stage 1 Evaluator, Follow-Up Agent, Formative Feedback, QuestionTimer, and Docker C Sandbox.

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus RL Adaptation
ablation_conditions.description: RL strategy disabled; difficulty locked at level 3 (mid).

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus Follow-Up Probing
ablation_conditions.description: Auxiliary follow-up generation disabled; strictly one question per topic.

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus Formative Feedback
ablation_conditions.description: Narrative and structured feedback disabled; score-only output.

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus Timing Modulation
ablation_conditions.description: Additive timing modifier f_time forced to 0.000 unconditionally.

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus Speech Prosody
ablation_conditions.description: Acoustic confidence and hesitation locked at neutral default 0.50.

ablation_conditions.name: Full System minus Coding Contribution
ablation_conditions.description: Coding sandbox executes in real Docker container, but coding pass rates are excluded from downstream candidate-state and difficulty adaptation updates.
